post.description: Implementation: 智慧养老手表管理系统/backend/internal/handlers/handler_old.go. Device body authentication or signed gateway receipt; not anonymous access. HarmonyOS clients send optional platform=harmonyos with protocolVersion=1; both are required together when platform is supplied. Authenticated success returns protocolVersion=1 and maxBatchSize=200 plus the existing bindingVersion/owner. Unsupported platform/version returns 400. Omit platform for the legacy login contract. Invalid credentials return 401 with code=DEVICE_AUTH_FAILED; disabled devices return 403.

Historical binding/version and sampling time are preserved; no freshness guarantee or cross-source merging.
